buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods

3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder to quote with Bid specific authorization directly from OEM otherwise offer will be summarily rejec ted without any back reference and no representation will be entertained 2. Firms having supply credentials of material in the category of " Spring Balance (Q3 Category)" shall only be considered. For past performance firm should attach proof of supply signed by either purchaser, consig ner, inspect or nominated by purchaser (should not be firm representative). For this purpose receipt note, inspection certificate, CRAC, receipted challan, work completion certificate etc should be attached. Proof o f supply should clearly indicate quantity supplied and date of supply. Only copy of purchase order, GeM co ntract, self signed tax invoice, self made performance statement will not establish that supply has been co mpleted. 3. Warranty Period: 36 months , Warranty/Guarantee certificate and test report to be submitted at the ti me of delivery. 4. Firm must upload the certificate, mentioning the percentage of local content in the material being offere d. Please enter 0 for fully imported items, and 100 for fully indigenous items. The definition and calculation of local content shall be in accordance with the Make in Indi a policy. The firm has to certify that the item offered meets the minimum local content and shall give details of the locations at which the local value ad dition is made. 5. If firm don't upload any requisite certificate along with bid, their offer will be summarily rejected. 6. Inspection by consignee. 7. No new document will be accepted after opening of bid through any channel. If firm do not submit perfo rmance document along with bid then offer will be summarily rejected and in representation no new docu ment will be accepted. If any conflict was found with other bid condition mentioned anywhere in bid document then above seven conditions will prevail. .
